description: This file defines the ContextAwarePluginInterface interface for Drupal, specifying methods for managing context definitions, context objects, context values, and context mappings within plugins.

classes.name: ContextAwarePluginInterface
classes.description: Interface for defining context aware plugins in Drupal, extending PluginInspectionInterface and providing methods for context management.

methods.name: getContextDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves an array of context definitions keyed by context name.

methods.name: getContextDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific context definition by name, may throw ContextException if not defined.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Retrieves all set context objects, may throw ContextException if contexts are defined but not set.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves a specific context object by name, may throw ContextException if not set.

methods.name: getContextValues
methods.description: Returns an array of all context values, with unset contexts as NULL.

methods.name: getContextValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific context, may throw ContextException if not set.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets a context object for a given name.

methods.name: setContextValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a context, validating against its definition, may throw ContextException if validation fails.

methods.name: validateContexts
methods.description: Validates all set context values, returning a list of violations.

methods.name: getContextMapping
methods.description: Returns a mapping of expected assignment names to actual context names.

methods.name: setContextMapping
methods.description: Sets a mapping of expected assignment names to context names.
